newsitem.title: USA: VideoServer posts loss amidst slow sales.
newsitem.headline: VideoServer posts loss amidst slow sales.

text.p: VideoServer Inc Thursday attributed its "disappointing financial results" for the second quarter to lower sales to its largest customer, PictureTel Corp, and lower demand from service providers.

The company posted a quarterly loss of $8.7 million, or $0.65 a share, including a $14 million pre-tax charge to account for its buying Promptus Communications. This compared with a profit of $2.2 million, or $0.17 a share, the year before.
Without the charge, VideoServer posted a net of $281,000, or $0.02 a share.

"The disappointing financial results for the second quarter reflect lower revenues due to lower sales to the PictureTel Corp ... and lower demand from service providers," said chief executive Robert Castle in a statement.

VideoServer on June 30 warned it would report a second-quarter loss of about $8 million to $9 million, or about $0.60 to $0.67 a share, including the one-time charge. Its stock dropped to 10-3/8 the next day, from 13-1/4.
The company's stock closed at 10-13/16 Thursday, down 7/16 and close to its 52-week low of 9-10/16.
